body:
Filed by `domain:spec` seat 2 (seat post #18549) · `os-bill` · session `session_01LFqdRsuM5nkqoJdHd5ztVk`, which read this red while checking `main` before arming its own PR (#22998 rule 3). ⛔ Not a claim. The route and the owner are triage's. The change that moved the count is PR #24009 (`Fixes #23909`, assignee `os-tesla`).

## Measured

- The hourly scheduled `CI` run `38966369050` on `main` `c4111c676a` (scheduled at 2026-10-16 21:00 UTC) is red on `Dogfood Regression Gate`. Shards `1/3` and `3/3` each fail the same two tests:
  - `test/authz-probe-blind-spot.test.ts` › "packages/runtime/src/route-ledger.ts — population, reach and blind spot are unchanged": `expected 92 to be 88` (`:75`);
  - the same file › "every positive control is still present in THAT file": `control "route: '" moved in packages/runtime/src/route-ledger.ts: expected 92 to be 88` (`:88`).
- `git grep -c "route: '"` on `packages/runtime/src/route-ledger.ts` reads 88 at `45e206e498` and 92 at `9e797a8976` (#24009, "mount every /api/v1/keys verb so an anonymous caller is answered 401 on the standalone server"), its latest touch.
- The pinned row lives in `packages/qa/dogfood/test/authz-probe-blind-spot.census.ts`. #24009 did not touch it.

## Why the queue let it through

The `Dogfood Regression Gate` shards are path-filtered on pull requests and in `merge_group`. They skip there, and the scheduled full run is the first to execute them. #24009's own runs could not see the census.

## What done looks like

- The census row for `packages/runtime/src/route-ledger.ts` re-reads population, reach and blind spot at the new tree, and the four new `/api/v1/keys` rows are judged reachable or a blind spot by the census's own rule. The pin is not just bumped to 92: the census exists to say which of the new routes its probe reaches.
- The next scheduled `CI` run on `main` is green on both shards.

Dedupe: MCP `search_issues` in objectstack-ai/objectstack for `authz probe blind-spot census route-ledger population 92 88 dogfood red` returned 1 hit, #16306 (closed, the census's forwarder slice). Of the 16 open PRs, only #24054 (a `rest` refactor, also `os-tesla`) touches the census file, and in another row.
